card.name: Just before the word dose
card.fires_on: The spot right before the word dose or dosage is completed, such as the DO in DOSE, Dos in Dosage, or absorbed before dose. Also fires on the gap before a dose amount in a dosing table.

modes.label: Split DOSE or Dosage
modes.description: The first piece of a dose word broken into parts, often in capitals.
modes.example: ium Bromide and Albuterol Sulfate Inhalation Solution should be discontinued immediately and alternative therapy instituted. DO NOT EXCEED RECOMMENDED<< DO>>SE Fatalities have been reported in association

modes.label: Word before dose
modes.description: A modifier such as absorbed that is followed by dose in radiation text.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE In the event of an overdose of gallium Ga 68 gozetotide, reduce the radiation<< absorbed>> dose to the patient where possible by increasing

modes.label: Space before amount
modes.description: A blank gap before a dose amount in a dosing list or table.
modes.example: 5 to 7 days Typhoid Fever 500 mg every 12 hours 10 days Uncomplicated Gonorrhea<< >>250 mg single dose single dose

card.writes: It pushes the model to write dose, dosage and related words next.
card.plain: It lights up when the next word is likely to be dose or dosage.
